text.description_html:
Pemko 318AV, Double Door Split Astragal/Meeting Stile

The Pemko 318AV door bottom seal is used for sealing the area between the bottom of the door and the threshold or floor surface. Split Astragal seals are installed on the face of both doors. They are used in place of a surface mount astragal on double doors with a gap of 1 inch.

Features and Specifications of the Mill Finish Aluminum with Gray Vinyl Insert Door Bottom:

  • Finish: Aluminum
  • Vinyl Insert Color: Gray
  • Length: 8' (96")
  • Come packaged with mounting screws.

Sold as a pair for a set of double doors. Special ordered item. Not Returnable.
